title: MultiUuError::MissingParts declared but never constructed
description: uuencoding-multi/src/error.rs:20 declares MissingParts { expected, present } with a Display impl. But reassemble() never returns this variant — it returns Ok(ReassembledFile { is_truncated: true, missing_parts: vec![...] }) when parts are absent. The variant is dead. Fix: same options as MIME-3bt.1. Recommended: add doc comment noting this is reserved / not currently returned, and file a separate issue to decide the long-term API direction.
close_reason: Fixed: doc comment now accurately states variant is reserved and not currently returned.
